evidenceLayout: tmp/cmp/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ holds one full log per verification command, each ending with an exit=<status> line. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. tmp/ is gitignored and never listed in writePaths. A missing or truncated log is not a pass. A step blocked by the sandbox (network, ~/.cache/tree-sitter, localhost, full nextest) is recorded as BLOCKED with the command, exit code and stderr; CMP-40 reruns it.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits the accepted design and all plans before fanout, and commits implementation after review, with AGENTS.md 1-6 section commit messages. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge. Only wf/syntax-fmt is pushed; never main.
executionModel.retryPolicy: Concurrent plans share one cargo target dir and one editor/node_modules. If cargo reports a build-directory lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker. A compile or typecheck error located in another concurrent plan's writePaths is transient: never edit that file; wait about 120 s and retry up to 10 times, then record it as BLOCKED for CMP-40. Examples: a wasm32 build during wave 1 hitting CMP-10's in-progress src/complete, or `tsc --noEmit` hitting a sibling's half-written .ts file. Never run npm install; no plan changes package.json or package-lock.json.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and a one-line intent snapshot in the plan's Progress Log. After the edit, record the post-edit sha256. If the file drifted from the last recorded hash, stop and report. Never edit outside writePaths. Each worker edits only its own plan's Progress Log. Formatting is limited to rustfmt on the plan's own .rs files (never `cargo fmt` without --check).
executionModel.serialReconciliation: CMP-40 owns README.md, impl-plans/README.md, plan archiving, the design Status lines, reruns of BLOCKED steps and the full gate. A defect found outside a worker's writePaths is recorded in that worker's Progress Log and repaired serially by CMP-40 or by the orchestrator's review step, with file, cause, fix and pre/post sha256.

designDecisionsAndRationale: The engine uses the reader's layout skeleton, because an erroring statement becomes a childless Error node (src/reader/line.rs:295).
Builtin snapshot for wasm (C3); the LSP adds manifest, package and checked-type details.
Keywords only in the :keyword context (C1); signatureHelp deferred (C2).
The repair gate allows indent-space plus empty-block, because space indentation causes empty-block (C4); the unit is 2..8 (C5).
Popup keys are intercepted only while open, except Ctrl-Space (C6).
No manual-mode classification: the ABI carries no mode (design 3.3, last bullet).
constraints: Work only on wf/syntax-fmt in this worktree; push only wf/syntax-fmt, never main.
Build on the committed session-222 formatter and tree-sitter work; touch it only for shared completion hooks.
AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, Rust files under 1000 lines, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo.
The completion core is wasm32-clean, never panics on partial input, and stays inside a documented per-keystroke budget (under 5 ms for a 2000-line document, native release).
No @codemirror/autocomplete, no EditorView dependency outside completion-view.ts, no new crate or npm dependencies.
Do not edit editor/src/app/apis.ts or editor/src/code/language.ts; mount.ts, main.ts and deps.ts get minimal wiring lines only.
Every plan owns at least one committed nextest, vitest or node test with a positive test count.
During fanout, gates are scoped to each plan's own files; workspace-wide gates run in CMP-40.
Manifest paths are concrete tracked paths only; never target/, editor/node_modules, editor/dist, tree-sitter-vact/node_modules or tmp/.
intentionalTradeoffs: The wasm path uses a builtin context snapshot (prelude natives, templates, spec-default manifest), so session-held names and project manifests appear only in the LSP (C3).
The LSP reply changes from CompletionResponse::Array to List with isIncomplete; one existing LSP test changes per design 4.2.
Keyword candidates appear only in the :keyword context, not mixed into heads (C1); signatureHelp is deferred (C2).
The repair accepts only indent-space plus empty-block errors and units 2..8; anything else is refused unchanged (C4, C5).
CompletionEngine.complete resolves to RawCompletion | null (null for status 2 and 3), a narrowing of design 6.1 that matches the service's null handling.
Tree-sitter highlighting stays full-reparse; incremental tree.edit is deferred.
supportedEdgeCases: Cursor inside strings or comments yields no candidates.
Partial, unterminated or invalid input at every char-boundary prefix of committed .vact files never panics.
Block lets are visible only after their statement and inside their block; inner scopes shadow outer ones.
PairKey at a native head's positional arity limit (k >= 1); an inst head with no earlier pair is Argument.
UTF-16 replace ranges for Japanese text and surrogate pairs in both LSP textEdits and the editor service.
IME composition suppresses the popup; Enter accepts only while the popup is open; Ctrl-Space triggers manually.
Missing or failing wasm disables completion after one failure and the editor keeps working.
2- and 4-space indented files are repaired; ambiguous widths, mixed tab/space lines and other reader errors are refused unchanged.
VACTR_WASM overrides the artifact path in editor/test/wasm/format.test.ts.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Remote or other non-typing document changes while the popup is open are handled only by the text-equality check on the next result (design 6.3).
Open-import unqualified names and session-held names in the web editor.
Canvas surface adapter: plan J1 replaces the single attachCompletion(editorView, ...) line in mount.ts at cutover.
User-QA C1-C6 defaults remain pending confirmation in design-docs/user-qa/pending-completion-questions.md.
